exoticIngredients.label: Concentrate of Tormented Souls
exoticIngredients.description: Sickly-sour ectoplasmic soup syphoned from those who bear corruption in their hearts.

exoticIngredients.label: Dilution of False Hope
exoticIngredients.description: A clear liquid adulterated with the sickly essence of those sworn to a false god.

exoticIngredients.label: Distillate of Hatred
exoticIngredients.description: Purest fury sieved from the ground and pulped corpses of the righteous.

exoticIngredients.label: Essence of Fear
exoticIngredients.description: Stolen and refined from the last breath of a craven victim.

exoticIngredients.label: Extract of Xeno-matter
exoticIngredients.description: Ichor, viscera or psychic spore extracted from an alien foe.

exoticIngredients.label: Infusion of Traitor's Blood
exoticIngredients.description: Crimson fluid extracted from the veins of those who have broken an oath of loyalty.

elixirs.label: Anfrak Silk
elixirs.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units.

elixirs.label: Xylocil
elixirs.effect: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by EMPEROR'S CHILDREN models.

elixirs.label: Shivversplit
elixirs.effect: Add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units.

elixirs.label: Heliotrophos
elixirs.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by EMPEROR'S CHILDREN models.

elixirs.label: Skorflense
elixirs.effect: Improve the Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by EMPEROR'S CHILDREN models by 1.

elixirs.label: Quail
elixirs.effect: Improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units by 1.

elixirs.label: Alacrine
elixirs.effect: The bearer's unit has the Fights First ability.

elixirs.label: Cerebresec
elixirs.effect: Once per battle round, when you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem, reduce the CP cost by 1.

elixirs.label: Thrynicine
elixirs.effect: Each time the bearer makes an attack, a successful Wound roll inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target (2 if the bearer has lost wounds).

elixirs.label: Salviqine Tears
elixirs.effect: Each enemy unit within 12" of the bearer that is below Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 if Below Half-strength.

elixirs.label: Sanctus Vi
elixirs.effect: The bearer has a 2+ invulnerable save.

elixirs.label: Excelsor X
elixirs.effect: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer's unit has shot (if not in Engagement Range), it can make a Normal move of up to 6".
